name: Trackr
author: KIZAFOX
description: Trackr c'est comme DPM.gg mais gratuit à 100%

scripts.release: node -e "const token = process.env.GH_TOKEN || process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN; const cert = process.env.CSC_LINK; const password = process.env.CSC_KEY_PASSWORD; if (!token) { console.error('Missing GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN. Use: $env:GH_TOKEN=... then npm run release'); process.exit(1); } if (!cert || !password) { console.error('Missing Windows signing variables. Set CSC_LINK and CSC_KEY_PASSWORD before running release.'); process.exit(1); }" && electron-builder --publish always
